title: SCA Workplace Politics: Advice for Facing Tough Conversations on Israel

chapters.title: Introduction to AJC and Anti-Semitism
chapters.about: AJC mission, IHRA definition, and anti-Zionism

chapters.title: Best Practices for Workplace Engagement
chapters.about: Communication tips, personal stories, and advocacy

chapters.title: Q&A: Interviewing and Culture
chapters.about: Assessing workplace culture during job interviews

summary: Brandon Pinsker from the American Jewish Committee provides practical advice for navigating workplace conversations regarding Israel and anti-Semitism. He discusses how to identify and counter common tropes and misinformation, while offering strategies for advocating for oneself and engaging with HR departments to ensure a safe and inclusive environment.
questions: How can I respectfully handle a supervisor who is being combative about Israel?
What should I do if I don't feel comfortable going to my company's HR department about anti-Semitism?
How can I advocate for the Jewish community to be included in my company's DEI initiatives?
What are some neutral, reliable sources to share with coworkers to provide a balanced perspective?
How can I assess if a potential employer will be a safe and tolerant environment for a Jewish employee during an interview?
